newsitem.title: UK: EMI charge, outlook overshadow capital plan.
newsitem.headline: EMI charge, outlook overshadow capital plan.

text.p: EMI Group Plc fell almost three percent on Tuesday as a hefty restructuring charge and modest outlook overshadowed plans to return 500 million stg to shareholders.

EMI shares were 33.5p lower at 1187.5p by 1155 GMT as the market reacted negatively to a series of announcements, including a 117 million stg provision to cover the cost of restructuring the company's North American music business.
"The size of the restructuring cost and the flatness of the market are two negatives outweighing the positive impact of the capital return," said analyst Jason Crisp of SocGen.
